meta_description: Velocity Electrics Ltd provides expert electrical installation and repair services across Birmingham. NICEIC certified, same-day emergency response available.
hero_subhead: From faulty wiring to new installations, we solve complex electrical problems other electricians miss — and we arrive fast.
services_heading: Electrical Installation & Repair Services in Birmingham
services_subhead: We handle everything from fault-finding and emergency repairs to full house rewires and cooker installations.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Faulty wiring, blown circuits, and electrical faults repaired fast. We troubleshoot problems other electricians struggle with and get you safe again quickly.

services.title: Electric Cooker Installation
services.desc: Professional electric cooker fitting with full certification. We handle the heavy-duty wiring and ensure your new cooker is installed to Building Regulations.

services.title: Lighting Installation & Repair
services.desc: New light fittings, rewiring, and fault diagnosis. Whether it's bedroom lights or spotlights throughout your home, we get it done neatly and safely.

services.title: Smoke Alarm & Safety Testing
services.desc: Faulty smoke alarms replaced and safety testing carried out. We ensure your home meets current fire safety standards and your alarms work when you need them.

services.title: House Rewiring & Upgrades
services.desc: Full house rewires and electrical upgrades to modern standards. We replace outdated fuse boxes, add new circuits, and bring your wiring up to code.

services.title: Fault-Finding & Diagnostics
services.desc: Can't find where an electrical fault is coming from? We use professional equipment to pinpoint the problem and fix it properly first time.

about_pullquote: We solve the problems other electricians leave unsolved.
about_para_1: Velocity Electrics Ltd is a Birmingham-based electrical installation company with over 12 years' experience serving homeowners and businesses across the city. Founded on the principle that electrical work should be done right the first time, we've built our reputation by tackling complex wiring issues and delivering installations that meet the highest standards.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we're knowledgeable, friendly, and honest. We don't oversell unnecessary work — we diagnose faults properly, explain what needs doing, and charge fairly. Whether you need an emergency repair at midnight or a full house rewire, you'll work with electricians who care about the quality of their work.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Customers Say About Velocity Electrics

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a faulty wiring issue that two other electricians couldn't figure out. Velocity came in, diagnosed it straight away, and fixed it properly. Very impressed with their knowledge and professionalism. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Easy communication, extremely friendly and knowledgeable about what we needed doing. The quality and neatness of his work was really good. Fitted two new lights for us and everything looks perfect. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: Needed a faulty smoke alarm replaced urgently and a new cooker wiring sorted. They came out same day, did brilliant work, and charged a fair price. No messing about, just reliable and professional. Top bloke.
reviews.author: James T.
